about: Every puzzle hint, as the header DISPLAYS it (with the motif and level prefix on short upright phones, #550 a42), fits the 3 lines the clamp draws: the 14 curated hints and the 876 generated ones (pzText). Graded by gate 12's TC-PZ-04c at its nine geometries; the short phones (320x568, 360x640, 375x667) and his 375x761 are the situations. NOT COVERED: iOS WebKit's text metrics (headless Chromium with gates/fonts.conf); the sideways layout (clamp 2 under 400 tall); his look.
